The Club

Paris meets
New York

Saint Germain is a private club bringing together a French, American and international community in New York — united by a shared desire to live the city to the fullest, build genuine connections and share exceptional moments.

Whether you run along the Hudson at dawn, play tennis on weekends, or prefer rooftop parties at sunset — you'll find your community here.

Activities

What we
share

Running
Weekly runs at Central Park, Brooklyn Bridge and along the Hudson. All levels welcome.
Sundays 8am
Tennis
Friendly matches and tournaments at Riverside Park. From casual to competitive, find your perfect partner.
Sat & Sun
Volley
Beach volleyball at East River Park and Randall's Island. Franco-American team spirit at its finest.
Wednesday eve
Evenings
Rooftops, Franco-American dinners, hidden bars and gallery openings — nights you'll actually remember.
Monthly
Meetups
Happy hours, brunches and bilingual networking. The club is, above all, about lasting human connections.
Bi-monthly
Launch Event · May 9, 2026

Where it
all began

On the evening of May 9th, Saint Germain officially launched — a rooftop in New York, the Manhattan skyline as backdrop, and a crowd of French and American friends who made it unforgettable. This was night one. Many more to come.
